title: Webb County commissioners to consider three renewable energy zones at Monday meeting
excerpt: The Webb County Commissioners Court will consider creating three renewable energy zones for wind and solar power at its meeting Monday, November 9, at 9 a.m. at the Webb County Courthouse, with a public hearing for each zone, according to KGNS.
content:
The Webb County Commissioners Court will consider creating three renewable energy zones for wind and solar power at its meeting Monday, November 9, according to KGNS.

The meeting is set for 9 a.m. at the Webb County Courthouse, 1000 Houston St., KGNS reported. Commissioners will hold a public hearing for each of the three proposed zones.

The meeting agenda also includes more than $3 million in Operation Lone Star funding, about $1 million for colonias, and a local preference policy for county projects, according to KGNS.

Source: KGNS, November 8, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
